title: Abacoa Golf Club

services.name: Driving Range
services.desc: Take your game to the next level at our practice facility, which includes a driving range featuring elevated target greens and a large practice green for putting only. Our driving range tee is mostly grass with a strip of state of the art synthetic turf. Abacoa only uses quality, name brand range balls in good condition for a superior range experience. The Driving Range is ready when you are with our outside Automated Range Ball Machine. The Range Ball Machine hours are daily from 6:45 am to 45 minutes before sunset. For your convenience, the Range Machine accepts credit cards and is available even after the pro shop closes. You may now text us for information on Tee Times, Range Hours,

services.name: Daily Clinics
services.desc: Regularly scheduled clinics at Abacoa Golf Club provide professional instruction in a group environment. Our PGA Instructors cover a variety of topics including Full Swing with Irons, Hybrids, Fairway Woods or Driver and Short Game skills including Putting, Chipping, Pitch Shots or Bunker Shots. The Sunday Game Improvement Clinic focuses on the variety of shots encountered in a typical round of golf. Daily clinics are restricted to (5) guests. blurb: The Abacoa Golf Course was the last course designed by renowned course architect Joe Lee before his death. In typical Joe Lee style, Abacoa’s lakes and bunkers meet its sloping fairways with little obstruction, and you’ll find scenic views with 14 of its 18 holes surrounded by water.
